title: Sprint 2 sparse TF-IDF sweep
hypothesis: Word and character TF-IDF choices and regularization can improve the existing sparse preference baseline on the fixed selection fold.
changed_factor: Sequentially vary analyzer, n-gram range, vocabulary size, min_df, and alpha while keeping the frozen split and training protocol fixed.
notes: Selection-only sweep. Fold 8 is reserved for calibration after the base sparse model is frozen; fold 9 remains untouched.
